description: Writes behavior-driven executable specs (Feature > Scenario > Specification, one assertion per test) from a feature's STORIES.md and PLAN.md, in C# or Lit/TypeScript, using the project's existing test framework. Use when stories are final and it's time to write the tests, or when asked to spec out, write tests first, or do BDD/TDD.
